accepted_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: responsive desktop login-page background for the fictional cross-platform strategy game SHADOWGRID
Input images: Image 1 is an approved architectural material and visual-style reference; Image 2 is an approved lighting, palette, and photographic-restraint reference. Do not reproduce either scene or composition.
Primary request: Create a new premium ultra-realistic background showing a calm access atrium inside an original contemporary corporate headquarters in a fictional German metropolis.
Scene/backdrop: physically plausible glass, dark stone, brushed metal, and concrete architecture; subtle exterior urban context through glass; no recognizable landmark or real location.
Subject: the architecture and controlled arrival space only, suggesting strategic access and institutional scale without depicting any illicit activity.
Style/medium: ultra-realistic architectural photography; high-end urban economic strategy simulation; cinematic corporate-thriller atmosphere; restrained subtle cyber-noir; natural material imperfections and realistic reflections.
Composition/framing: exact 16:9 landscape intent, intended final size 2048x1152; human eye-level wide composition. Keep the central 44% of the frame from roughly 18% to 88% height calm, darker, and low-detail for an opaque login form overlay. Place the strongest architectural detail toward the far right and frame edges. Preserve a quiet, high-contrast-safe region near the upper-left for the existing brand mark. No bright mullion, light fixture, horizon, or focal object may cross the form-safe center.
Lighting/mood: warm late afternoon transitioning toward blue hour; natural cinematic light; calm, controlled, credible, inviting but serious.
Color palette: black and anthracite framing, cool neutral blue-gray, restrained warm gold highlights; no saturated neon.
Materials/textures: physically plausible dark glass, brushed metal, concrete, stone, subtle floor texture, realistic scale.
Text: none.
Constraints: entirely original fictional architecture; no people or faces; no text, signage, interface screens, captions, logos, watermarks, signatures, readable plates, addresses, flags, uniforms, authorities, weapons, crime symbols, or real brands. High readability under a centered UI overlay. Must remain convincing when cover-cropped at common desktop ratios.
Avoid: copied landmark-photo angles, fantasy skyscrapers, impossible geometry, distorted buildings, duplicate objects, floating elements, excessive neon, warning red, cartoon, anime, comic, plastic mobile-game rendering, blur, low resolution, compression artifacts, fake writing.
notes: The central form-safe area is dark, low-detail and free of bright structural lines.
No visible person, text, logo, private identifier, authority mark, weapon or illicit activity.
Architecture and material reflections are physically plausible and consistent with the frozen style lock.
